run_slurm_sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep across Atari environments using submitit on a SLURM cluster
run_slurm_sweep_local_dry: run the slurm sweep script locally in dry mode to preview job commands without submitting
run_all_configs: run all_configs to iterate over every hyperparameter combination from the sweep dictionary
run_config_to_argv: run config_to_argv to convert a config dictionary into a command line argument list
run_prefix_string: run prefix_string to generate a unique log directory prefix from a sweep config
